Your severe cramping pain, bloated belly, repeated vomiting and no bowel movement for three days can mean a blocked bowel, which needs urgent imaging, fluids and a surgical opinion today. Do not eat or drink on the way. If you become faint, get a fever, vomit blood, or the pain becomes constant and severe, call 911 instead of travelling yourself.
